set.body:
Implement the JVM host/controller translating JavaFX mouse, scroll, zoom, and resize events into shared SurfaceViewAction values. Support rotate, pan, zoom, reset, canonical lateral/medial/anterior/posterior/dorsal/ventral viewpoints, linked or independent bilateral cameras, explicit hemisphere separation, and configurable side-by-side ordering. Never infer anatomical direction from screen coordinates alone.

Use JavaFX PickResult intersected node, face, point, normal, and texture coordinates to recover SurfaceId and FaceId, then shared barycentric or nearest-vertex logic for VertexId and layer readouts. Add hover throttling, click selection, crosshair/annotation chrome through graphics Scene, and accessibility-friendly keyboard navigation.

Acceptance: asymmetric orientation fixtures prove L/R and dorsal/ventral behavior for both hemispheres; camera roundtrips and resize preserve targets; picks agree with reference oracle; camera interaction performs zero mesh/atlas uploads; event handlers are disposable; live JavaFX interaction receipt records viewpoint, selected face/vertex, upload counters, and p50/p95 navigation/pick timing.
set.title: JavaFX surface interaction: anatomical cameras, bilateral layout, navigation, and picking
